flags.message: Frozen distribution_count=2 (band 'elevated') counts the May 19 2026 distribution of ancillary motion 25M82 (leave to file a sealed supplemental appendix) alongside the petition's own single June 17 2026 distribution for the 9/28/2026 long conference.
